# Changelog

Binaries and notes of every release are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/releases){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

## 0.1.17

Aligned with the current OnlineSim API.

- `wait_sms_verification` is read-only: it no longer moves the order to its next SMS after a code. It retries rate
  limits and temporary errors until the timeout and reports an order that ended without SMS.
- The API key is sent as a Bearer header; HTTP 456 / 429 answers are reported as API errors.
- Rentals: time left is shown correctly (the API gives minutes); `extend_sms_rental` takes one of the rental's own
  extension periods and explains why a rental cannot be extended; renting is a reservation charged by the first SMS
  (at once for countries marked `charged at once`); stock per rent period; clearer `NO_NUMBER`, `NO_COMPLETE_TZID` and
  `NO_CLOSE_RENT_US` answers.
- Error explanations match the current API codes.
- The balance shows the amount available for orders (balance − frozen), also in the tray.
- `onlinesim login` does not save a key the API rejects.
- Duplicate ids no longer count towards the 20-id limit.

## 0.1.16 and earlier

See [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/releases){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.


# CLI

The CLI runs the same operations as the [MCP tools](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/tools) and prints the same text. Every command has `--help`.

## Account

```bash
onlinesim login                 # save the API key (prompted, hidden)
onlinesim login --apikey KEY    # non-interactive
onlinesim logout                # remove the stored key
onlinesim doctor                # config, key, API reachability, endpoint
onlinesim balance
```

`login` checks the key with the balance request. A key the API rejects (`ERROR_WRONG_KEY`) is not saved; on a network
error the key is saved with a warning.

## Quick SMS

```bash
onlinesim sms search                    # top services
onlinesim sms search telegram
onlinesim sms countries telegram        # countries, prices, stock
onlinesim sms list-countries            # every country, no service filter
onlinesim sms order telegram 7          # serviceId countryId — reserves the price
onlinesim sms check                     # all active orders
onlinesim sms check 1001 1002
onlinesim sms cancel 1001               # without ids: closes ALL active orders
onlinesim sms list                      # active orders and rentals
```

## Rent

```bash
onlinesim rent list                     # countries and day tiers
onlinesim rent order 7 3                # rentalId days — reserves, first SMS charges
onlinesim rent messages                 # all rentals; or: rent messages 1001
onlinesim rent extend 1001 1            # days: an extension period shown by `rent messages`
onlinesim rent cancel 1001              # without ids: closes ALL active rentals
```

## Server and clients

```bash
onlinesim mcp                           # start the MCP server (tray where available)
onlinesim mcp --bind 127.0.0.1:9000
onlinesim mcp --no-tray
onlinesim mcp install [--client cursor|vscode|claude|codex|all] [--project|--global]
onlinesim mcp autostart install|status|start|uninstall
```

See [Connect a client](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/clients) and [Configuration](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/configuration).

## Settings

```bash
onlinesim config show                   # path, base URL, language, key status (never the key)
onlinesim config path
onlinesim config set --lang ru
onlinesim config set --base-url https://onlinesim.host/api/
```

## JSON output

`--format json` prints one envelope on stdout, for scripts and integrations:

```bash
onlinesim --format json sms search tele
```

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "command": "sms.search",
  "data": {
    "query": "tele",
    "total": 1,
    "services": [
      { "service_id": "telegram", "name": "telegram", "countries": 1, "min_price": 1.2 }
    ]
  }
}
```

On failure `ok` is `false` and the exit code is non-zero:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "command": "sms.countries",
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_NO_SERVICE",
    "message": "No matching SMS service in stock (or service missing). …"
  }
}
```

`command` is `balance`, `sms.search`, `sms.countries`, `sms.list-countries`, `sms.order`, `sms.check`, `sms.cancel`,
`sms.list`, `rent.list`, `rent.order`, `rent.messages`, `rent.extend`, `rent.cancel`, `login`, `doctor`,
`config.show`, ….

## Global flags

| Flag                        | Meaning                                                |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--format text|json`        | Human text (default) or the JSON envelope.             |
| `--color auto|always|never` | Colors in text output.                                 |
| `-v`, `--verbose`           | Debug logs on stderr (ignored when `RUST_LOG` is set). |
| `--no-update-check`         | Skip the daily GitHub release check.                   |


# Connect a client

Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp` (or the address you pass to `--bind`). The transport is
[Streamable HTTP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/basic/transports#streamable-http){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}: one `/mcp`
endpoint, JSON-RPC over POST, SSE when needed. Clients discover the tools with `tools/list`, so the config only needs
the URL.

`onlinesim mcp` must be running while the client works — start it by hand or enable
[autostart](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/configuration#autostart).

## Auto-wire

`onlinesim mcp install` writes the client config for you (it does not start the server):

```bash
onlinesim mcp install                                  # Cursor, this project (default)
onlinesim mcp install --client cursor --global         # Cursor, all projects
onlinesim mcp install --client vscode --project        # VS Code Copilot, this project
onlinesim mcp install --client claude --project        # Claude Code, .mcp.json
onlinesim mcp install --client all --project           # Cursor + VS Code + Claude project files
onlinesim mcp install --client codex --global          # Codex, ~/.codex/config.toml
```

| Flag                     | Meaning                                                |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--client`               | `cursor` (default), `vscode`, `claude`, `codex`, `all` |
| `--project` / `--global` | Project file (default) or user-wide file               |
| `--dir <path>`           | Project root (default: current directory)              |
| `--url <url>`            | Endpoint (default `http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp`)         |
| `--force`                | Overwrite an existing `onlinesim` entry                |

The tray menu has the same install items.

## Cursor

| Scope   | File                 | CLI                                              |
| ------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Project | `.cursor/mcp.json`   | `onlinesim mcp install`                          |
| Global  | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` | `onlinesim mcp install --client cursor --global` |

Or Command Palette → **Open MCP settings** → **Add custom MCP**. The file:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "onlinesim": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## Claude Code

| Scope                     | How                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Project (shared via git)  | `onlinesim mcp install --client claude --project` → `.mcp.json` (same JSON as Cursor)                                                   |
| Global (all projects)     | `onlinesim mcp install --client claude --global`, or `claude mcp add --scope user --transport http onlinesim http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp` |
| Local (you, this project) | `claude mcp add --transport http onlinesim http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp`                                                                   |

## VS Code (GitHub Copilot)

```bash
onlinesim mcp install --client vscode --project
```

`.vscode/mcp.json` — the root key is `servers`, not `mcpServers`:

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "onlinesim": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## Codex

```bash
onlinesim mcp install --client codex --global
# or
codex mcp add onlinesim --url http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp
```

`~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.onlinesim]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp"
```

## Claude Desktop / Claude.ai

- A public HTTPS URL: **Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector** and paste the endpoint.
- A local `http://127.0.0.1/…` URL in `claude_desktop_config.json` is usually not supported (that file is for stdio
  servers). Use a stdio bridge instead:
  ```json
  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "onlinesim": {
        "command": "npx",
        "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp", "--transport", "http-only"]
      }
    }
  }
  ```

## Other clients

Any Streamable HTTP MCP client works with the same URL. The server info is `Onlinesim Numbers`; it offers tools only
(no resources or prompts) and sends a short playbook in its `instructions`.

## Another machine

The server binds to loopback only. To reach it from another host see
[network safety](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/configuration#network-safety): it has no authentication of its own.


# Configuration

## API key

The key comes from your [OnlineSim profile](https://onlinesim.io/v2/profile/api){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The server and the CLI read it from,
in this order:

1. `ONLINESIM_APIKEY` (environment);
2. the config file written by `onlinesim login`.

It is sent to the API as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, never in a URL, and never appears in tool arguments, answers
or logs. A running server re-reads the config on each tool call, so `onlinesim login` / `logout` take effect without a
restart.

## Config file

`onlinesim config path` prints it: `~/.config/onlinesim/config.json` on Linux,
`~/Library/Application Support/io.onlinesim.onlinesim/config.json` on macOS,
`%APPDATA%\onlinesim\onlinesim\config\config.json` on Windows.

```json
{
  "apikey": "…",
  "base_url": "https://onlinesim.host/api/",
  "lang": "en"
}
```

| Field      | Default                       | Set with                                                 |
| ---------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apikey`   | —                             | `onlinesim login` / `onlinesim logout`                   |
| `base_url` | `https://onlinesim.host/api/` | `onlinesim config set --base-url …`                      |
| `lang`     | `en`                          | `onlinesim config set --lang ru` (language of API texts) |

## Environment

| Variable              | Meaning                                                  |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ONLINESIM_APIKEY`    | API key; overrides the config file.                      |
| `ONLINESIM_NO_UPDATE` | `1` turns off the daily release check.                   |
| `RUST_LOG`            | Log filter, e.g. `onlinesim_mcp=debug` (wins over `-v`). |

## Logs

`onlinesim mcp` logs to stderr at `info`: start-up (bind address, where the key comes from — never the key), each tool
call with its duration and result, and wait start / finish (the outcome only, never the SMS text or code).

```bash
onlinesim mcp                                  # onlinesim_mcp=info
onlinesim -v mcp                               # onlinesim_mcp=debug (catalog cache, …)
RUST_LOG=onlinesim_mcp=debug onlinesim mcp     # explicit filter
```

## Autostart

Start the server at login / reboot, the same way on every OS:

| OS      | User (default)                          | `--system`                 |
| ------- | --------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Windows | HKCU Run                                | HKLM Run (admin)           |
| macOS   | LaunchAgent in `~/Library/LaunchAgents` | LaunchDaemon (sudo)        |
| Linux   | systemd `--user`                        | systemd system unit (sudo) |

```bash
onlinesim mcp autostart install               # enable + start in the background
onlinesim mcp autostart install --bind 127.0.0.1:8787
onlinesim mcp autostart status
onlinesim mcp autostart start                 # start now, autostart unchanged
onlinesim mcp autostart uninstall
sudo onlinesim mcp autostart install --system
```

The user level runs as you, so `onlinesim login` and the config keep working.

## System tray

While `onlinesim mcp` runs, a tray icon shows the available balance and the active Quick SMS and rental numbers, and
lets you:

- copy a number, an SMS code or the full message;
- get a desktop notification on a new SMS (the code is copied automatically) — toggle **Notify on SMS**;
- cancel a Quick SMS order;
- install the Cursor / VS Code client config;
- toggle **Start at login**;
- **Quit MCP**.

`--no-tray` runs headless (SSH, CI). On Linux the tray needs a desktop session (`DISPLAY` / `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`) and the
GTK / AppIndicator libraries (`libgtk-3`, `libayatana-appindicator3`); the Linux release binaries are headless.

## Network safety

The MCP endpoint has **no authentication**: anyone who can reach it can spend your balance. It binds to
`127.0.0.1:8787` and refuses other addresses unless you pass `--allow-remote`:

```bash
onlinesim mcp --bind 0.0.0.0:8787 --allow-remote
```

Do that only behind your own HTTPS and access control (a reverse proxy with auth, a VPN). Requests with a `Host` header
other than the bind address and loopback are rejected.


# Install

Prebuilt binaries for every release are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/releases){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.
The install scripts pick the right one, put `onlinesim` on disk and print how to connect a client.

| OS      | Targets                                                         |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| macOS   | `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `x86_64-apple-darwin` (with tray)       |
| Linux   | `x86_64` / `aarch64`, `gnu` or `musl` (headless, no tray)       |
| Windows | `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc` (with tray) |

## macOS and Linux

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/master/install.sh | sh
```

The script downloads the latest release for your OS and CPU into `~/.local/bin/onlinesim`. On macOS it ad-hoc signs
the binary so Gatekeeper lets it run. If `~/.local/bin` is not on `PATH`, it prints the line to add.

| Variable                | Default                | Meaning                                                           |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ONLINESIM_INSTALL_DIR` | `~/.local/bin`         | Where to put the binary.                                          |
| `ONLINESIM_LIBC`        | `gnu`                  | Linux only: `musl` for a fully static binary (Alpine, old glibc). |
| `ONLINESIM_MCP_REPO`    | `on-org/onlinesim-mcp` | Repository to download from.                                      |

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/master/install.sh | ONLINESIM_LIBC=musl sh
```

## Windows

In PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/master/install.ps1 | iex
```

It installs `onlinesim.exe` into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\onlinesim\bin` (override with `$env:ONLINESIM_INSTALL_DIR`) and adds
that folder to your user `PATH`. Open a new terminal afterwards.

## Manual download

Download `onlinesim-<target>.tar.gz` (or `.zip` on Windows) from
[the latest release](https://github.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/releases/latest){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}, unpack it and put `onlinesim` somewhere on
`PATH`. Check:

```bash
onlinesim --version
```

## Agent skill

The skill lets the agent install the binary, start the server and ask you for the API key when needed:

```bash
npx skills add on-org/onlinesim-mcp                  # this workspace
npx skills add on-org/onlinesim-mcp -g               # all projects
npx skills add on-org/onlinesim-mcp -a cursor -y     # Cursor only
```

Open a new agent chat. The skill runs `scripts/ensure-ready` first (binary → MCP up → auth). If there is no API key,
the agent asks you to paste it and runs `onlinesim login --apikey …`.

To have the rules in every Cursor chat, copy
[`skills/onlinesim-mcp/rules/onlinesim-mcp.mdc`](https://github.com/on-org/onlinesim-mcp/blob/master/skills/onlinesim-mcp/rules/onlinesim-mcp.mdc){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}
to `.cursor/rules/` of your project, or paste it into **Cursor → Settings → Rules → User Rules**.

## After installing

```bash
onlinesim login      # paste the API key
onlinesim doctor     # config, key and API reachability
onlinesim mcp        # start the server
```

Then [connect your client](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/clients).

## Updates

The CLI checks GitHub for a newer release at most once a day and prints the update command. Run the install script
again to update. Turn the check off with `--no-update-check` or `ONLINESIM_NO_UPDATE=1`.

## Uninstall

```bash
onlinesim mcp autostart uninstall    # if you enabled autostart
onlinesim logout                     # remove the stored key
rm ~/.local/bin/onlinesim
```

On Windows delete `%LOCALAPPDATA%\onlinesim\bin\onlinesim.exe`. The config file location is printed by
`onlinesim config path`.


# MCP tools

Every tool answers with plain text written for the agent: the data, the ids in `[brackets]` and what to do next.
A failed call is an MCP tool error (`isError: true`) whose text explains the API error code and the next step; it is
not a protocol error. Arguments are camelCase JSON.

Ids in `[brackets]`: `serviceId` (slug, e.g. `telegram`), `countryId` / `rentalId` (numeric country code, e.g. `7`),
Order ID / Receipt ID (`tzid` of an order or a rental). Never invent them — take them from catalog tools or
`list_sms_orders`.

Bulk tools take `orderIds` / `receiptIds`: 1–20 ids (duplicates are dropped), or omit / `[]` for every active one.
Cancel-all only when the user explicitly asks to close everything. One bulk call, never one call per number.

## Agent flows

Quick SMS:

```text
get_account_balance
→ search_sms_services → find_cheapest_sms_countries   (or get_sms_service_countries)
→ order_sms_verification(serviceId, countryId)
→ the user enters the number on the target site and requests the SMS
→ wait_sms_verification(orderId)                       (or check_sms_verification every 15–30 s)
→ cancel_sms_verification(orderIds)
```

Rent:

```text
list_sms_rentals → rent_sms_number(rentalId, days)
→ get_sms_rental_messages(receiptIds)                  (every 15–30 s)
→ extend_sms_rental(receiptId, days) / cancel_sms_rental(receiptIds)
```

| Tool                                                                                                 | Kind      | Spends                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------- |
| [`search_sms_services`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#search_sms_services)                 | catalog   | —                            |
| [`get_sms_service_countries`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#get_sms_service_countries)     | catalog   | —                            |
| [`find_cheapest_sms_countries`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#find_cheapest_sms_countries) | catalog   | —                            |
| [`list_sms_countries`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#list_sms_countries)                   | catalog   | —                            |
| [`list_sms_rentals`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#list_sms_rentals)                       | catalog   | —                            |
| [`get_account_balance`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#get_account_balance)                 | account   | —                            |
| [`order_sms_verification`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#order_sms_verification)           | Quick SMS | reserves the price           |
| [`wait_sms_verification`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#wait_sms_verification)             | Quick SMS | —                            |
| [`check_sms_verification`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#check_sms_verification)           | Quick SMS | —                            |
| [`cancel_sms_verification`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#cancel_sms_verification)         | Quick SMS | refunds an order without SMS |
| [`list_sms_orders`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#list_sms_orders)                         | both      | —                            |
| [`rent_sms_number`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#rent_sms_number)                         | Rent      | reserves, first SMS charges  |
| [`get_sms_rental_messages`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#get_sms_rental_messages)         | Rent      | —                            |
| [`extend_sms_rental`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#extend_sms_rental)                     | Rent      | charges at once              |
| [`cancel_sms_rental`](https://on-org.github.io/onlinesim-mcp/#cancel_sms_rental)                     | Rent      | releases a reservation       |

Catalog answers come from the OnlineSim tariff lists, cached in the server for up to 5 minutes. Balance, orders and
rentals always go to the API. Stock is a hint, not a guarantee: an order can still get `NO_NUMBER`.

## Catalog

### search_sms_services

Find Quick SMS services by name. Read-only.

| Argument | Type   | Required | Description                                                                           |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `query`  | string | no       | Name to search (`"Telegram"`, `"Google"`). Omit for the top services by availability. |

Answer: up to 30 services (50 with a query), each `name [serviceId] | from $price | N countries`. Only services in
stock. If nothing matches, search `"other"` for the catch-all service.

```text
SMS verification services matching "tele" (1):
  telegram [telegram] | from $1.20 | 1 countries
```

### get_sms_service_countries

In-stock countries of one service, most stock first. Read-only.

| Argument    | Type   | Required | Description                                                        |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `serviceId` | string | yes      | `serviceId` from `search_sms_services`, or the exact service name. |

Answer: `country [countryId] | $price | N in stock`. When the id is not exact, a list of similar services
(`Did you mean: …`) instead. Error `ERROR_NO_SERVICE` when nothing matches.

```text
Countries for google [google] (2), most stock first:
  United Kingdom [44] | $0.20 | 100 in stock
  Russia [7] | $0.30 | 100 in stock
```

### find_cheapest_sms_countries

The cheapest in-stock countries of a service — use it instead of guessing a `countryId`. Read-only.

| Argument    | Type    | Required | Description                             |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `serviceId` | string  | yes      | `serviceId` from `search_sms_services`. |
| `limit`     | integer | no       | 1–20, default 5.                        |

Answer: like `get_sms_service_countries`, sorted by price. Suggestions or `ERROR_NO_SERVICE` the same way.

### list_sms_countries

Every Quick SMS country (directory, no prices). No arguments. Read-only.

Answer: `name · countryId [code] · on|off`. The `countryId` is the country's dial code. For prices and stock use a
`serviceId` with the two tools above.

### list_sms_rentals

The long-term rental catalog. No arguments. Read-only.

Answer: per country `name [rentalId] | in stock | OUT OF STOCK`, and per rent period `N day(s) | $price | in stock`.
Countries marked `charged at once, no refund` (e.g. US) are charged when rented instead of on the first SMS.

```text
Long-term SMS rental numbers (keep the same receive-only number for days):
  russia [7] | in stock
    1 day(s) | $1.00 | in stock
    3 day(s) | $2.50 | in stock
    7 day(s) | $5.00 | in stock
```

## Account

### get_account_balance

No arguments. Read-only.

Answer: available for orders (= balance − frozen), total balance, frozen `zbalance` (reserved by open orders and
unconfirmed rentals), income when the account has it, and the top-up link.

```text
Available for orders: $7.50
Account balance: $10.00
Frozen (zbalance, reserved by open orders/rentals): $2.50
```

## Quick SMS

### order_sms_verification

Buy a number for one service. **Spends balance**: the price is reserved at once and refunded if the order is closed
without an SMS.

| Argument    | Type    | Required | Description                                                                   |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `serviceId` | string  | yes      | Exact `serviceId` from the catalog.                                           |
| `countryId` | integer | yes      | `countryId` from `get_sms_service_countries` / `find_cheapest_sms_countries`. |

Answer: `Order ID: [tzid]`, the phone number, service, country, and the cancel guard.

```text
Quick SMS number ordered (price reserved on the balance).
Order ID: [1]
Phone number (use this on the target service): +7900000001
Service: telegram | Country: 7
```

Errors: `NO_NUMBER` (try another country), `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`,
`EXCEEDED_CONCURRENT_OPERATIONS` (too many open numbers without SMS), `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`,
subscription accounts: `COUNTRY_NOT_ALLOWED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ERR_SERVICE`, `SUBSCRIPTION_WRONG_ACTIVE_PACKAGE_ID`,
`NO_ACTIVE_PACKAGE`.

### wait_sms_verification

Wait for one order until it has an SMS, ends, or the timeout passes. Read-only: it never closes the order and never
moves it to the next SMS, so a later check or wait shows the same messages. The user must already have requested the
SMS on the target site.

| Argument      | Type    | Required | Description                                        |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `orderId`     | integer | yes      | Order ID from `order_sms_verification`.            |
| `timeoutSecs` | integer | no       | 5–60, default 45. The order is polled every \~5 s. |

Answer, one of:

- **received** — the messages, the code found in them (`Code: 123456`) and the number of polls;
- **timeout** — the order is still open; wait again or check later;
- **ended** — the order finished or failed without an SMS (`TZ_OVER_OK`, `ERROR_NO_ITEMS`);
- **not found** — not an active order of this account.

Rate limits (`TRY_AGAIN_LATER`, HTTP 429), `ERROR_UNDEFINED`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR` and network errors are
retried until the timeout. At most 4 waits run at the same time.

### check_sms_verification

The inbox of one or more orders, one API call. Read-only.

| Argument   | Type       | Required | Description                                         |
| ---------- | ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `orderIds` | integer [] | no       | 1–20 Order IDs; omit or `[]` for all active orders. |

Answer: for one id — waiting / SMS received with the code and every message / not found. For several — one line per
order and a summary (`Received: 1. Waiting: 2. Not found: 0.`). Statuses: `TZ_NUM_WAIT` — waiting for SMS,
`TZ_NUM_ANSWER` — SMS received.

### cancel_sms_verification

Close orders. A closed order without SMS is refunded; an order with an SMS is finished.

| Argument   | Type       | Required | Description                                                |
| ---------- | ---------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `orderIds` | integer [] | no       | 1–20 Order IDs; omit or `[]` closes **all** active orders. |

Answer: one block per order — closed, or not closed with the code and its explanation. An order without SMS cannot be
closed during its guard interval (120 s from the order, 300 s for WhatsApp): that comes back as a refusal with
`NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, the phone, service, country and `guard_secs` — wait that long and retry. Other codes:
`ERROR_WRONG_TZID` (unknown id), `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR` (the same order touched less than 5 s ago).

### list_sms_orders

Active Quick SMS orders and rentals with their ids — to recover after a crash or a lost context. No arguments.
Read-only.

Answer: `Order ID [tzid] | number | service | country | status` and
`Receipt ID [tzid] | number | country | days | rental status | time left`.

## Rent

A rental keeps a number for days and receives every SMS sent to it. `rent_sms_number` reserves the price: the rental
waits up to \~20 minutes for its first SMS (status *waiting for first SMS*). The first real SMS confirms it and charges
the price; without one the rental closes and the reservation is released. Countries marked `charged at once` in
`list_sms_rentals` are confirmed and charged immediately.

### rent_sms_number

Rent a number. **Spends balance** (reservation, charged by the first SMS).

| Argument   | Type    | Required | Description                                  |
| ---------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `rentalId` | integer | yes      | `rentalId` from `list_sms_rentals`.          |
| `days`     | integer | yes      | One of the day tiers listed for that rental. |

Answer: `Receipt ID: [tzid]`, the number (without the country code), the price and whether it is reserved or charged,
the time left for the first SMS, and how to extend and cancel.

Errors: `NO_NUMBER` (no rental number for that country/period — pick another from `list_sms_rentals`),
`UNDEFINED_DAYS`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`.

### get_sms_rental_messages

Rental inboxes, one API call. Read-only.

| Argument     | Type       | Required | Description                                            |
| ------------ | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `receiptIds` | integer [] | no       | 1–20 Receipt IDs; omit or `[]` for all active rentals. |

Answer: per rental — the number, status (waiting for first SMS / active / frozen), time left, the extension periods
with prices, and the messages newest first as `sender: text`, with the code of the newest SMS.

### extend_sms_rental

Add days to a rental. **Spends balance** at once.

| Argument    | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `receiptId` | integer | yes      | Receipt ID.                                                                                                         |
| `days`      | integer | yes      | One of **this rental's** extension periods, as listed by `get_sms_rental_messages` (not a `list_sms_rentals` tier). |

Only a confirmed rental (after its first SMS) that was rented with extension can be extended. The tool reads the rental
first and explains a refusal: not confirmed yet, cannot be extended, or `days` is not one of its periods (with the
list). Answer: the new total days, time left and total cost.

Errors: `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (the API refused, e.g. a repeat within 10 s or the rental closed).

### cancel_sms_rental

Close rentals.

| Argument     | Type       | Required | Description                                                   |
| ------------ | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `receiptIds` | integer [] | no       | 1–20 Receipt IDs; omit or `[]` closes **all** active rentals. |

A rental still waiting for its first SMS can be closed 120 s after it started; its reservation is released. A confirmed
rental closes without refund. Refusals come back per rental: `NO_COMPLETE_TZID` with `guard_secs`, `NO_CLOSE_RENT_US`
(US numbers close only when the period ends), `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` (unknown id), `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## Errors any tool can return

| Code                  | Meaning                                                                               |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ERROR_WRONG_KEY`     | No or wrong API key — run `onlinesim login` or set `ONLINESIM_APIKEY`.                |
| `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`     | The account is blocked; contact OnlineSim support.                                    |
| `ACCOUNT_CLEANED`     | The account was deleted.                                                              |
| `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED`  | The account email is not confirmed.                                                   |
| `API_ACCESS_DISABLED` | API access is off in the profile.                                                     |
| `API_ACCESS_IP`       | This IP is not in the profile allowlist.                                              |
| `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`     | Rate limit (400 requests/min per profile) or a temporary error — wait and retry once. |

An unknown code is shown as is with a generic hint.
